comment.text: FZD10 S22 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Adrenocortical carcinoma; Papillary renal cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting FZD10 residue S22 have been observed in adrenocortical carcinoma, lung adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.
